Zoe (CS): Quick follow-up from today: we need a short statuspage line, an enterprise briefing template (SLA impact + next steps), clear owners for remediation, and a policy for sharing RCAs with customers who ask. Who volunteers?

Aiden (SRE): I'll take remediation. Plan: emergency scaling tweak in 24h, longer fix (backpressure + tests) in 10 business days. Filing INC-5207 now.

Priya (PM): Noting recurrence: similar queue-growth in April and July. I'll run the retro and own recurring-incident actions.

tracker-bot: Created INC-5207: https://tracker.redwood.ai/INC-5207

Rowan (Comms): Draft short statuspage copy (non-technical):
"09:1809:46 UTC 1 elevated latency affected some API requests causing slower responses or timeouts for a subset of customers. A mitigation is in place and we are monitoring. A short incident summary will be posted within 24 hours and a full RCA within 7 business days. For enterprise impact, contact your account team or support@redwood.ai."

Isha (Security): Policy: public summary ok. Redacted RCAs to affected customers on request after Security review. Full operational logs/diagrams require Legal + NDA if customers request raw artifacts. Add security review step to tracker.

Zoe (CS): Action items (added to INC-5207):
- Aiden: emergency scaling tweak 1 due 2026-11-10
- Aiden: durable fix + tests 1 due 2026-11-24
- Priya: retro + recurring-incident doc 1 due 2026-11-13
- Rowan: publish short status (24h) 1 due 2026-11-10
- Zoe + Sales: enterprise note template (SLA + next steps) 1 due 2026-11-11
- Isha: redaction checklist & sign-off flow 1 due 2026-11-12

Priya (PM): Scheduling retro Friday 10:00 PST. Invite SRE, infra-test, CS, Comms, Security, Sales.

Rowan (Comms): I’ll post the short status now after a 10m review and paste the link here. Keep public language high level, SLA impact in private note only.

Aiden (SRE): Will add dashboard alerts for queue depth and 90th pct latency; ETA 5 days.

Zoe (CS): Thanks 1 owners assigned above. I’ll compile affected accounts and attach to INC-5207, then coordinate customer outreach once Comm copy is live. :white_check_mark:
